ir.name: all_pairs_gap_rank_blend_exp_mad
ir.intuition: Weight all pairs by normalized positive gap blended with an exponential decay on rank difference, modulated by instance_obj_mad powered by gamma, emphasizing instance-level margin dispersion for robust conditioning under full all-pairs topology.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    rank = feature_cache['rank']
    instance_obj_mad = feature_cache['instance_obj_mad']
    eps = 1e-6
    mask = objective[:, :, None] < objective[:, None, :]
    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'all_pairs_gap_rank_blend_exp_mad', 'weight_family': 'gap_rank_blend'})
    gap = (objective[b_idx, loser_idx] - objective[b_idx, winner_idx]).clamp_min(0.0)
    norm_gap = gap / instance_obj_mad[b_idx].clamp_min(eps)
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', 1.0))
    gamma = float(extra.get('gamma', 1.0))
    rank_diff = (rank[b_idx, loser_idx] - rank[b_idx, winner_idx]).abs()
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', 3.0))
    base_weight = norm_gap.pow(alpha) * instance_obj_mad[b_idx].clamp_min(eps).pow(gamma)
    blend = (-(beta * rank_diff)).exp()
    raw_weight = base_weight * blend
    weight = raw_weight.clamp(0.1, 3.5)
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weight, meta={'builder': 'all_pairs_gap_rank_blend_exp_mad', 'weight_family': 'gap_rank_blend'})

ir.name: refined_hyperparameter_tuning_M2_v3_unique
ir.intuition: Stabilize normalization by clamping sums and replace direct weighted mean with safe division to fix runtime; preserve sigmoid margin on advantage_gap.
ir.pseudocode:
epsilon=1e-6
lpw=batch['log_prob_w']
lpl=batch['log_prob_l']
weight=batch.get('weight', ones_like(lpw))
adv_gap=batch['advantage_gap']
abs_adv=abs(adv_gap)
mean_abs_adv=mean(abs_adv)
norm_adv=max(mean_abs_adv, epsilon)
diff=(lpw - lpl)/norm_adv
sigmoid_diff=sigmoid(diff)
loss = -log(clamp(sigmoid_diff, min=epsilon))
weighted_loss=loss*weight
loss_sum=sum(weighted_loss)
weight_sum=sum(weight)
weight_sum_safe=max(weight_sum, epsilon)
loss=loss_sum/weight_sum_safe
return loss

def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    epsilon = 1e-6
    lpw = batch["log_prob_w"]
    lpl = batch["log_prob_l"]
    weight = batch.get("weight", ops.ones_like(lpw))
    advantage_gap = batch.get("advantage_gap", ops.zeros_like(lpw))
    abs_adv = ops.abs(advantage_gap)
    mean_abs_adv = ops.mean(abs_adv)
    norm_adv = ops.maximum(mean_abs_adv, epsilon)
    diff = ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), norm_adv)
    sigmoid_diff = ops.sigmoid(diff)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.log(ops.clamp(sigmoid_diff, min=epsilon)))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    loss_sum = ops.sum(weighted_loss)
    weight_sum = ops.sum(weight)
    weight_sum_safe = ops.maximum(weight_sum, epsilon)
    return ops.div(loss_sum, weight_sum_safe)
